problem: The initial development checklist is the designated entry point for development work, and its body records at lines 734-735 that six capabilities remain outside approved scope. That sentence was last written at 17:37 on 2026-08-05 by commit 91827a5. Between 18:19 and 21:54 on the same day, three of the six listed items each received a human approval decision for a minimal slice and a green implementation, recorded in immutable decision and evidence records, but no later commit revised the sentence. The checklist therefore keeps presenting already approved and implemented capabilities as unapproved. The checklist's own operating rules require scope changes to be recorded by revising the document with reason and human decision, and no test or validator compares body-text scope statements against decision records, so the drift stayed invisible until a manual cross-reference during a review-history investigation found it.
impact: a reader planning from the checklist entry point treats approved and implemented capabilities as unapproved and may re-propose, re-approve or re-implement them
the checkbox-to-Evidence discipline does not catch this class of staleness because the stale claim sits in prose without a checkbox
the heuristic recurrence survey found twelve checklist-absent TDD work-unit clusters, so the insertion pattern that produced this drift is recurring rather than one-off

prose scope statements have no machine signal tying them to later decision records, unlike digests, which are already covered by OBS-RC3-AUTHORITY-REFERENCE-DIGEST-DRIFT-2026-08-06-V1 for front matter references
boundary: preserve this observation as immutable source
do not treat this observation as an Improvement Candidate, Human Triage Decision or Issue Record

the source field points at the earliest contradicting approval decision rather than the checklist, because the checklist keeps changing and a mutable source would reproduce the drift this observation reports
do not edit the checklist, the approval decisions or the green evidence on the basis of this observation alone
counts under recurrence_survey are heuristic and must be re-measured before any reconciliation relies on them
